result.edit: The failure occurs when checking the sequence 011100 at cycle 24 where not_match is incorrectly 1 instead of match being 1. The issue stems from the sf6 state transition incorrectly branching based on data input, which can cause premature group termination. Changing sf6's transition to always go to sf1 (failure state) preserves the group boundary and ensures proper sequence detection. This matches the specification's requirement to skip entire groups when the first bit doesn't match.
